svg.title: Orchestrator Inspector — WPF window layout and station flow
svg.desc: Three-panel WPF window: left 3D Helix viewport, centre signal trace, right station inspector. Below: station hierarchy from orchestrator down to registry.
svg.text: Each station lights up in sequence (400 ms per hop) after a command runs. Click any node or row to inspect input / output.
Helix Toolkit (MIT) handles camera orbit, zoom, and hit-testing. HelixToolkit.Wpf NuGet, .NET 8 WPF, 21.AgentInfrastructure project reference.
